verdict.rationale: Build and type-check scaling is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. The evidence covers runtime reactivity, TypeScript/Vite integration, and bundle size, but nothing on build or type-check times in large or monorepo codebases. One community comment mentions using Solid on a 'largish web product', but it concerns reactivity and debugging, not build performance.

support.subject: As a developer, I know how the framework's build and type-check times scale in large, multi-thousand-component codebases or monorepos
